findings.description: When the server rejects an add request (for example an empty title, an unknown category, or a non-positive-step amount such as 1.005), it returns HTTP 400 and re-renders the blank Add expense form with no error message explaining what was wrong.
repro: POST /expenses with form fields title='' category='travel' amount='5' (bypassing the browser's required attribute)
Observe status 400 and the blank Add expense form with no error text

notes: Tested: viewer list total ($399.99) and category filters (travel $185.25, meals $177.25, office $37.49) match the rows. Editor add shows 'Expense saved', adds exactly one row, and persists after reload (total $410.24). Editor edit of Team lunch 68.40 to 75.00 updates the list and total straight away ($416.84). Viewer sees no edit, add or delete controls, and GET/POST edit and new routes return 403. Mobile width (375px) has no horizontal scroll. Side effects on test data: added 'QA Test Taxi' ($10.25) and a $0 expense titled 'Zero' via direct POST. Not tested: the Delete button, the perf category beyond one page load (682 ms), and the Edit flash message.

cost.notes: estimate from 76496 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0008-$0.0092
